name: Talky - LibertyTalk Live Events
description: Your stream events become game events. LibertyTalk sends follows, subs, bits, raids, channel points and Super Chats to the Talky bridge on your PC, and the mod runs the matching workflow in your game: a zombie named after the follower, a horde for a raid, the helicopter for 1000 bits. <LINE> <LINE> Single player, hosted game or dedicated server. On a server, install Talky on the server too: the server runs the effects for every player, and admins and moderators may use Talky by default (Sandbox Options > Talky). Needs the Talky bridge (Node.js 18 or later) and a public tunnel on the streamer's PC: download and setup guide on GitHub. Press F8 in game to open the Talky window.
